text: Closed with live JDK22 evidence. JVM and Scala.js targeted suites each pass 24/24 across broadcast, loop-kind, and mutable laws. Final two-fork elementwise matrix is 1.107x NumPy geometric mean with 0.578x worst case and 3.68x same-host geometric-mean speedup. Contiguous public add is 14.54 us and 247.13 us; allocation is raw output plus about 808 B, below the 2048 B limit. Reusable addInto is 10.49 us and 209.13 us versus raw controls 10.97 us and 228.14 us; its remaining 152-155 B/op is the benchmark final scalar read. javap dispatchers are compact and optimized Scala.js contains direct Float64Array loops without collection callbacks. The 1024 transpose row was noisy in both matrix and isolated repeat and is explicitly marked for quiet-runner replacement. Evidence: modules/benchmarks/results/2026-07-27-local-jdk22-elementwise/.
